content:
We have a template 390319 that seems to break C-N bond between benzylic carbon and nitrogen, generating a benzylic carbon attached to heterocycle (n1:c:n:c:n:1). That looks promising: it splits the side chain into a benzylic fragment (C-CH2-?) and a heterocycle (maybe azetidine). Actually the product side: [C:4]-[CH2;D2;+0:5]-[N;H0;D3;+0:1](-[C:2])-[C:3] is the bond we break. The retro template yields N-C-C-C-... plus a heterocycle fragment.

Thus we can use template_id 390319 for disconnection of benzylic C-N.

Now we need to apply templates to get precursors.

First apply amide-breaking template (647549) to target.
